note: 0.1.5 (E-4), as lane.test.ts reads the same summaries with lane.ts: a one-line Next steps section splits after a wait mark that ends an item with a `;`, `,`, `.` or `)` after it too (`1. Read log · waits: job; 2. Write notes · todo` is two items, so the free step 2 keeps a hard-blocked copy in-progress), and a wait mark inside an item's words does not split it; Step 1 is the first Next steps item not done, so with item 1 done item 2's `waits: job` or `waits: you` holds Step 1 under `Gate: none` (blocked) and an unmarked item 2 leaves Step 1 to its own words (in-progress)
